desc:
⚽ Save penalties and score amazing goals in 1v1 duels! 

🧤 Be a goalkeeper and kicker: aim the shot with your finger, mouse or controller, add curve and power... and fly to save! 

🏆 MODES 
• 1 vs 1 multiplayer against other players
• Against the CPU while waiting for a rival
• Private rooms to play with friends
• World: choose your team and reach the Final 
• Spectator mode: watch live matches 

🛒 Gloves, balls, arches, stadiums, celebrations, and surprise envelopes. 
🎁 Daily streak, gifts for playing, missions and badges. 
⭐ Level up and improve your archery skills. 
💎 Premium: more coins and double the daily missions. 

📅 SURPRISE EVENT this Saturday! Activate the notification to avoid missing it. 
🔄 Football, Soccer, Ball, Goalkeeper, Saving Goals...
